name: Cisco Meraki - Overview
description: The Cisco Meraki - Overview dashboard provides insights into high severity threats, port scan attacks, HTTP requests, and Air Marshall events in your environment. Panels also display overviews for message types and trends, as well as names and name trends.
title: Cisco Meraki - Overview

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Metricsdatasource}}  urls
|	parse regex " (?<name>\S*?)\s(?<msg_type>urls|firewall|events|ids-alerts|security_event|airmarshal_events?)\s+" nodrop
| kv regex "=(.*?)(?:\s|$)" "src", "dst", "mac" as src, dst, mac_address nodrop
| kv "agent" as user_agent nodrop
| parse "request: * *" as method, url nodrop
| parse field=src "*:*" as src_ip, src_port nodrop | parse field=dst "*:*" as dest_ip, dest_port nodrop
| where msg_type="urls"
| where if ("{{action}}" = "*", true, action matches "{{action}}") AND if ("{{msg_type}}" = "*", true, msg_type matches "{{msg_type}}") AND if ("{{dest_port}}" = "*", true, dest_port matches "{{dest_port}}") AND if ("{{url}}" = "*", true, url matches "{{url}}") AND if ("{{dest_ip}}" = "*", true, dest_ip matches "{{dest_ip}}") AND if ("{{method}}" = "*", true, method matches "{{method}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}") AND if ("{{type}}" = "*", true, type matches "{{type}}")
| count as Requests

_sourceCategory={{Metricsdatasource}} 
|	parse regex " (?<name>\S*?)\s(?<msg_type>urls|firewall|events|ids-alerts|security_event|airmarshal_events?)\s+"
| timeslice 1h
| where if ("{{action}}" = "*", true, action matches "{{action}}") AND if ("{{msg_type}}" = "*", true, msg_type matches "{{msg_type}}") AND if ("{{dest_port}}" = "*", true, dest_port matches "{{dest_port}}") AND if ("{{url}}" = "*", true, url matches "{{url}}") AND if ("{{dest_ip}}" = "*", true, dest_ip matches "{{dest_ip}}") AND if ("{{method}}" = "*", true, method matches "{{method}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}") AND if ("{{type}}" = "*", true, type matches "{{type}}")
| count as eventCount by _timeslice, name
| transpose row _timeslice column name

_sourceCategory={{Metricsdatasource}}  firewall (allow or "Group Policy Allow" or 0)
|	parse regex " (?<name>\S*?)\s(?<msg_type>urls|firewall|events|ids-alerts|security_event|airmarshal_events?)\s+" nodrop
| kv regex "=(.*?)(?:\s|$)" "src", "dst", "mac", "protocol", "sport", "dport", "type" as src_ip, dest_ip, mac_address, protocol, src_port, dest_port, type  nodrop
| parse "pattern: *" as pattern nodrop
|	parse regex " firewall\s(?<action>allow|deny?)(?:\s+|$)" nodrop
| if (action="" and (pattern="Group Policy Allow" or pattern matches "0 *" or pattern matches "allow *"), "allow", if (action="" and (pattern="Group Policy Deny" or pattern matches "1 *" or pattern matches "deny *" ), "deny", action)) as action
| where msg_type="firewall" and action = "allow"
| where if ("{{action}}" = "*", true, action matches "{{action}}") AND if ("{{msg_type}}" = "*", true, msg_type matches "{{msg_type}}") AND if ("{{dest_port}}" = "*", true, dest_port matches "{{dest_port}}") AND if ("{{url}}" = "*", true, url matches "{{url}}") AND if ("{{dest_ip}}" = "*", true, dest_ip matches "{{dest_ip}}") AND if ("{{method}}" = "*", true, method matches "{{method}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}") AND if ("{{type}}" = "*", true, type matches "{{type}}")
| count by dest_ip
| lookup latitude, longitude from geo://location on ip=dest_ip
| where !isNull(latitude)

_sourceCategory={{Metricsdatasource}} 
|	parse regex " (?<name>\S*?)\s(?<msg_type>urls|firewall|events|ids-alerts|security_event|airmarshal_events?)\s+"
| where if ("{{action}}" = "*", true, action matches "{{action}}") AND if ("{{msg_type}}" = "*", true, msg_type matches "{{msg_type}}") AND if ("{{dest_port}}" = "*", true, dest_port matches "{{dest_port}}") AND if ("{{url}}" = "*", true, url matches "{{url}}") AND if ("{{dest_ip}}" = "*", true, dest_ip matches "{{dest_ip}}") AND if ("{{method}}" = "*", true, method matches "{{method}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}") AND if ("{{type}}" = "*", true, type matches "{{type}}")
| count as eventCount by msg_type
| sort by eventCount, msg_type asc

_sourceCategory={{Metricsdatasource}}  airmarshal_events type (rogue_ssid_detected or ssid_spoofing_detected or containing_device or device_alerting)
|	parse regex " (?<name>\S*?)\s(?<msg_type>urls|firewall|events|ids-alerts|security_event|airmarshal_events?)\s+" nodrop
| kv regex "=(.*?)(?:\s|$)" "type" nodrop
| kv regex "=\'(.*?)(?:\')" "ssid", "bssid", "src", "dst", "wired_mac", "vlan_id", "channel", "rssi", "fc_type", "fc_subtype", "vap" as ssid, bssid, src_ip, dest_ip, wired_mac, vlan_id, channel, rssi, fc_type, fc_subtype, vap nodrop
| where msg_type matches "airmarshal_events" and type in ("rogue_ssid_detected", "ssid_spoofing_detected", "containing_device", "device_alerting")
| where if ("{{action}}" = "*", true, action matches "{{action}}") AND if ("{{msg_type}}" = "*", true, msg_type matches "{{msg_type}}") AND if ("{{dest_port}}" = "*", true, dest_port matches "{{dest_port}}") AND if ("{{url}}" = "*", true, url matches "{{url}}") AND if ("{{dest_ip}}" = "*", true, dest_ip matches "{{dest_ip}}") AND if ("{{method}}" = "*", true, method matches "{{method}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}") AND if ("{{type}}" = "*", true, type matches "{{type}}")
| count as eventCount by type
| sort by eventCount, type asc

_sourceCategory={{Metricsdatasource}}  "security_event"
|	parse regex " (?<name>\S*?)\s(?<msg_type>urls|firewall|events|ids-alerts|security_event|airmarshal_events?)\s+" nodrop
| parse regex "security_event\s+(?<type>\S+)\s" nodrop
| kv regex "=(.*?)(?:\s|$)" "signature", "priority", "dhost", "shost", "direction", "protocol", "src", "dst", "name", "sha256", "disposition", "action", "url", "mac" as signature, priority, dhost, shost, direction, protocol, src, dst, filename, sha256, disposition, action, url, mac nodrop
| parse regex " message:\s*(?<msg>.*)" nodrop
| parse field=src "*:*" as src_ip, src_port nodrop | parse field=dst "*:*" as dest_ip, dest_port nodrop | parse field=filename "\'*\'" as filename nodrop | parse field=disposition "\'*\'" as disposition nodrop
| where priority="1" and msg_type="security_event"
| if (priority="1", "High", if (priority="2", "Medium", if (priority="3", "Low", if (priority="4", "Very Low", priority)))) as priority
| where if ("{{action}}" = "*", true, action matches "{{action}}") AND if ("{{msg_type}}" = "*", true, msg_type matches "{{msg_type}}") AND if ("{{dest_port}}" = "*", true, dest_port matches "{{dest_port}}") AND if ("{{url}}" = "*", true, url matches "{{url}}") AND if ("{{dest_ip}}" = "*", true, dest_ip matches "{{dest_ip}}") AND if ("{{method}}" = "*", true, method matches "{{method}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}") AND if ("{{type}}" = "*", true, type matches "{{type}}")
| count as threatCount

| count as eventCount1 by _timeslice, msg_type
| transpose row _timeslice column msg_type

_sourceCategory={{Metricsdatasource}} 
|	parse regex " (?<name>\S*?)\s(?<msg_type>urls|firewall|events|ids-alerts|security_event|airmarshal_events?)\s+"
| where if ("{{action}}" = "*", true, action matches "{{action}}") AND if ("{{msg_type}}" = "*", true, msg_type matches "{{msg_type}}") AND if ("{{dest_port}}" = "*", true, dest_port matches "{{dest_port}}") AND if ("{{url}}" = "*", true, url matches "{{url}}") AND if ("{{dest_ip}}" = "*", true, dest_ip matches "{{dest_ip}}") AND if ("{{method}}" = "*", true, method matches "{{method}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}") AND if ("{{type}}" = "*", true, type matches "{{type}}")
| count as eventCount by name

_sourceCategory={{Metricsdatasource}}  firewall (allow or "Group Policy Allow" or 0) dport
|	parse regex " (?<name>\S*?)\s(?<msg_type>urls|firewall|events|ids-alerts|security_event|airmarshal_events?)\s+" nodrop
| kv regex "=(.*?)(?:\s|$)" "src", "dst", "mac", "protocol", "sport", "dport", "type" as src_ip, dest_ip, mac_address, protocol, src_port, dest_port, type  nodrop
| parse "pattern: *" as pattern nodrop
|	parse regex " firewall\s(?<action>allow|deny?)(?:\s+|$)" nodrop
| if (action="" and (pattern="Group Policy Allow" or pattern matches "0 *" or pattern matches "allow *"), "allow", if (action="" and (pattern="Group Policy Deny" or pattern matches "1 *" or pattern matches "deny *" ), "deny", action)) as action
| where msg_type="firewall" and action = "allow" and !isEmpty(dest_port)
| where if ("{{action}}" = "*", true, action matches "{{action}}") AND if ("{{msg_type}}" = "*", true, msg_type matches "{{msg_type}}") AND if ("{{dest_port}}" = "*", true, dest_port matches "{{dest_port}}") AND if ("{{url}}" = "*", true, url matches "{{url}}") AND if ("{{dest_ip}}" = "*", true, dest_ip matches "{{dest_ip}}") AND if ("{{method}}" = "*", true, method matches "{{method}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}") AND if ("{{type}}" = "*", true, type matches "{{type}}")

| count by dest_port , dest_ip
| count as %"UniqueDestPorts" by dest_ip
| where %"UniqueDestPorts" > 10
| top 100 dest_ip by %"UniqueDestPorts", dest_ip asc
